title: 第26章 震惊全场第27章 大开眼界
content_zh:
“赢……赢了？”
“练气六层，打赢了练气九层？”
“那一剑……你们看清了吗？那是什么剑法？”
“没有，太快了，我只看到一道雷光！”
议论声如同潮水般涌起，越来越大，越来越密集。
数千名外门弟子的目光，此刻全都汇聚在那个单膝跪在擂台上的少年身上。
有震惊，有敬畏，有嫉妒，有好奇，也有恐惧。
一个练气六层的五行灵根废物，一剑击败练气九层。
这不合常理。
这颠覆了所有人的认知。
擂台上，徐长生单膝跪地，大口大口地喘着粗气。
他面色苍白如纸，额头上的汗珠如雨般滚落，握剑的手在微微颤抖。
体内灵气，已经被那一剑彻底抽干。
他连站起来的力气都没有了。
但，他赢了！
那些之前还在嘲笑徐长生的摇光峰弟子，一个个张大了嘴巴，脸上还残留着方才的笑意，此刻却凝固成了滑稽的表情。
而天枢峰的弟子们则是面面相觑，眼中满是震惊和难以置信。
一个小小的杂役，不止修行到了练气六层，更是一招秒杀了练气九层的赵四海！
此人，到底是什么怪物！？
就连无涯的目光，也转移到了徐长生的身上，那双冷漠的眸子，第一次露出了认真的神色。

他在思考，那宛如雷霆降世的一剑，自己能不能躲得过去。
“如果我提前提防的话，有五成把握！”
“大比第一名的位置，只能是我！”
无涯握紧了拳头，眼中闪过一抹坚定。
高台上，七位峰主的反应各不相同。
钱万两张大了嘴巴，手里端着的茶杯悬在半空，茶水都洒了出来，他却浑然不觉。
石破天更是直接从椅子上站了起来，虎目圆睁，死死盯着擂台上那个单薄的身影，嘴巴里喃喃道。
“这一剑……这一剑的威力，已经摸到筑基的门槛了！”
何婆婆佝偻着背，浑浊的老眼微微睁开，那双眼中有精光一闪而逝。
她仔细端详着徐长生，目光在他腰间的短剑上停留了一瞬，又落在他身上，若有所思地点了点头。
苏慕白依旧是那副阴柔的表情，嘴角挂着一丝若有若无的笑意，但那双细长的眼睛里，却闪过一丝凝重。
他是剑修。
content_en:
"Win...win?"
"Sixth level of Qi training, defeated the ninth level of Qi training?"
"That sword... did you see it clearly? What kind of sword technique is that?"
"No, it was too fast, I only saw a flash of lightning!"
The discussion surged like a tide, getting louder and denser.
The eyes of thousands of outer disciples were all focused on the young man kneeling on the ring.
There was shock, awe, jealousy, curiosity, and fear.
A waste of five elements spiritual roots at the sixth level of Qi training, defeated the ninth level of Qi training with one sword.
This doesn't make sense.
This subverts everyone's understanding.
On the ring, Xu Changsheng knelt on one knee, breathing heavily.
His face was as pale as paper, beads of sweat rolled down his forehead like rain, and the hand holding the sword was trembling slightly.
The spiritual energy in his body had been completely drained by that sword.
He didn't even have the strength to stand up.
But, he won!
Those Yaoguang Peak disciples who were still laughing at Xu Changsheng opened their mouths wide. The smiles still on their faces had turned into funny expressions at this moment.
The disciples of Tianshu Peak looked at each other with shock and disbelief in their eyes.
This little handyman not only reached the sixth level of Qi training, but he also instantly killed Zhao Sihai who was at the ninth level of Qi training with one move!
What kind of monster is this person! ?
Even Wuya's gaze shifted to Xu Changsheng, and his cold eyes showed a serious look for the first time.
He was thinking whether he could dodge the sword that was like thunder coming to the world.
"If I take precautions in advance, I'm 50% sure!"
"The first place in the competition can only be mine!"
Wuya clenched his fists, a flash of determination flashed in his eyes.
On the high platform, the seven peak masters had different reactions.
Qian Wanliang opened his mouth, the tea cup in his hand was hanging in the air, and the tea spilled out, but he didn't even notice.
Shi Potian stood up from his chair, eyes wide open, staring at the thin figure on the stage, and murmured.
"This sword... the power of this sword has reached the threshold of foundation building!"
Granny He hunched her back, her muddy old eyes opened slightly, and there was a flash of light in those eyes.
She looked at Xu Changsheng carefully, her eyes rested on the dagger at his waist for a moment, then fell on him again, and nodded thoughtfully.
Su Mubai still had the same feminine expression, with a faint smile hanging on the corner of his mouth, but a trace of solemnity flashed in his slender eyes.
He is a swordsman.
